verdict.rationale: The evidence never documents per-account or per-program transaction or velocity limits, holds on suspicious activity, or account freezes with reinstatement paths. The only nearby item is generic 'configurable controls' on cards, which is an adjacent card feature rather than the account and program risk controls this story asks for. Dashboard access to compliance data does not establish these controls either.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can set risk controls per account and per program — transaction and velocity limits, holds on suspicious activity, and account freezes with documented reinstatement paths
